description: This file defines an immutable class ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder that implements PolicyPlaceholder. It provides a singleton instance and methods to resolve placeholder values related to policy IDs, specifically for placeholders like policy:id, policy:namespace, and policy:name.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyPlaceholder
classes.description: An immutable singleton class that extends AbstractEntityPlaceholder<PolicyId> and implements PolicyPlaceholder, responsible for resolving policy-related placeholders.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for the placeholder, which is 'policy'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder given a policy ID and the placeholder string. Checks for non-empty placeholder, non-null policy ID, and if the policy ID is of type PolicyId, performs resolution, otherwise returns Optional.empty().
